Each chapter has a name, shown when it starts. The HUD card and the truck screen show where you are (Chapter 4/10, Finale, Endless 2). Deep-run unlocks are spread over the whole season.

After each normal level the team votes on the next level's route (Run › Votes, or the Shop's vote strip): Safe (the level as usual) or one of two risky routes, each a risk (more monsters, elites, a higher haul goal, a map modifier...) and a reward (gear, Scrap, luck or crafting parts).
It's decided when everyone has voted, or when the next level starts. No votes = Safe; a tie goes to the safer route. Milestone (boss) levels have no route vote.
The chosen route shows on the truck banner and on your HUD card while you play it.
After each milestone boss (not the finale) the team votes in Run › Votes: one of 3 heat cards, or Skip. No votes or a tie = Skip. It's decided when everyone has voted, or when the next level starts.
Heat only goes up: a card stays for the rest of the run. Skipping is how the team keeps it where it is.
Each point of heat (up to 10): +4% haul Scrap and +1 gear and shop luck. Never more XP.
Cards: Monster Surge (1), Lean Shop (1), Blackout (1), Elite Swarm (2), Hardened Bosses (2), Glass Cannon (2), Fragile Goods (2), Short Fuse (2), Iron Bodies (3), Thin Wallets (3).
Records on the Account tab: the highest heat a chapter was cleared at, and the heat at Victory, per difficulty. Heat shows as a chip on the HUD card and on the truck banner.

Every {cfg:Milestones/Every} levels is a milestone level ({cfg:Milestones/Enabled?on here:off here}). It always has a milestone boss: more modifiers, more health, and a Legendary drop for every player.

Clearing it reaches the milestone and starts the next chapter. Each chapter adds {cfg:Milestones/ChapterThreat} to the threat rating, and {cfg:Milestones/ChapterRewards}% more XP and Scrap and +1 gear and shop luck.
The HUD and the truck and shop banner show the chapter and how many levels are left to the next milestone.

After a milestone each player picks one reward in Run › Votes: a Unique (a Legendary for a slot, one you don't have yet) or a Scrap payout ({cfg:Milestones/ScrapPayout} at the first milestone, more for each one after).
You pick in the truck or the shop, with a confirm. There's no rush: it waits in the run save until you pick, even across a reload.

After a milestone the team votes on one of three run boons. A regular boss kill can also start a vote ({cfg:Boons/BossVoteChance}% chance). The winner works for everyone for the rest of the run, and boons stack.

The vote ends when everyone has voted, or when the next level starts. Most votes wins; a tie, or no votes at all, is decided at random. You can change your vote until then. Vote in the truck or the shop.
The team's boons are listed in the Shop tab's Run Boons section, and their 2-letter codes show on the HUD (Settings: Run boons on the HUD).

Every level the team clears adds 1 to the streak ({cfg:Streaks/Enabled?on here:off here}). Each streak level gives +{cfg:Streaks/XpPerLevel}% XP, +{cfg:Streaks/ScrapPerLevel}% Scrap from the haul and +{cfg:Streaks/LuckPerLevel} luck, for up to {cfg:Streaks/Cap} streak levels.
A death (one a death save doesn't stop) costs {cfg:Streaks/DeathPenalty} streak level(s). A lost level: {cfg:Streaks/FailMode}.
Streak and chapter bonuses together are capped at {cfg:Streaks/MaxTotalBonus}%.

The crew level (1-10) is shared by the whole team and resets with the run ({cfg:Crew/Enabled?on here:off here}). Crew XP comes from levels cleared, extraction points, contracts, team contracts, elites, bosses and milestones.

Each crew level adds a small team-wide bonus: 2 an extra Featured item in the shop, 3 +5% XP, 4 +10% max health, 5 +5% haul Scrap, 6 +1 luck, 7 contracts pay +10%, 8 +5% more XP, 9 mod shop -5%, 10 milestone payouts +25%.
The crew level is in the row along the top of the Contracts tab (select it to see every bonus). Crew XP and Scrap bonuses share the {cfg:Streaks/MaxTotalBonus}% cap with the streak and chapters.
When a run ends every player gets a recap on the Account tab (Runs): levels, chapter, haul, bosses, best moments and MVPs. It never pops up over the game.
Your personal bests (most levels, best streak, highest chapter, most Scrap and bosses in a run, biggest haul in one level) and your last 20 runs are kept on your account.

How every tab is laid out

Tabs come in four groups: Character (Class, Attributes, Perks), Loot (Gear, Shop), Run (Contracts, Votes, Research) and Options (Settings, Host, Account, Guide). Keyboard: 1-4 or Tab / Shift+Tab switch the group, Q / E the tab inside it, 5-9 jump to Gear, Shop, Votes, Contracts and Settings. Controller: LT / RT and LB / RB. A group comes back on the tab you left it on.

Run › Votes has every vote and choice in one place: route, heat, boons (or End / Endless), your milestone reward, team contracts and crew votes - each a small card with its options in a row and "2/4 voted" with an icon per player (who voted for what, unless the host keeps votes private). Click an option to vote or change your vote; point at a vote (or click its title to keep it) for every option in full, the rules and who voted, in the panel on the right. Decided votes move to Recent results at the bottom. Notices open it on the one that needs you.
Top: the tabs, then a slim bar with your class, level, XP, Scrap, skill and attribute points, Research Data and how many things need you. Click any of them to go to its tab.

Middle: the tab's own content on the left. On the right, the detail panel: whatever you point at or select, in full, always in the same order (what it is, what it does now, what changes next, what it needs, its buttons).
Bottom: the action bar (Confirm, Reset, Undo and the tab's main actions), then the keys you can press.

Statuses look the same everywhere, each with its own shape: Available (dot), Pending (half dot), Selected (diamond), Locked (padlock), Maxed (star), Equipped (tick), New (sparkle), Cursed (triangle), In development (striped square).
Settings: changes apply at once so you can see them. Undo takes them back, Save keeps them. Closing the menu with changes not saved asks first.
In the menu, move with WASD, the arrow keys or the d-pad. {key:confirm} selects, {key:back} goes back and {key:tabs} switch tabs.
